title: Entanglement Dynamics with a Stochastic Non-Hermitian Hamiltonian away from Exceptional Points
summary: Although non-Hermitian dynamics near exceptional points (EPs) provide a route to accelerated entanglement generation, entanglement can also be generated far from EPs at comparable or even higher rates. However, the behavior of such entanglement in open systems remains largely unexplored, rendering it highly susceptible to environmental noise. Here, we study entanglement dynamics in two coupled qubits described by a non-Hermitian Hamiltonian, where the dissipative rates are subject to stochastic noise. We focus on the regime away from EPs.
